name: Teratoma of the Central Nervous System
aliases: Central Nervous System Germ Cell Tumor

criteria.description: Histopathological identification of mature or immature tissues from all three germ layers within the CNS lesion
MRI or CT showing a heterogeneous mass with cystic, solid, and calcified components in typical CNS locations
Elevated cerebrospinal fluid or serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) or beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) in some cases

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation plus characteristic imaging findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Tumor markers are supportive but not always elevated; biopsy is essential for definitive diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Intracranial mass effect with raised intracranial pressure

searchTerms: fluid buildup in brain from tumor blockage
brain swelling due to blocked fluid flow
water on the brain caused by tumor

common.notes: Due to hypothalamic or pituitary involvement

searchTerms: cranial nerve palsies causing facial or eye problems
back pain with nerve compression signs
weakness or numbness from spinal cord squeezing

laboratory: Elevated serum or CSF alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) in some cases
imaging: MRI showing heterogeneous intracranial mass with cystic, solid, and calcified components
CT scan demonstrating calcifications and mass effect
Hydrocephalus on imaging secondary to obstruction
genetic: No consistent germline genetic mutations identified; somatic mutations may be present in tumor tissue
other: Histopathology revealing tissues derived from ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm

distinguishingFeatures: Arises from ependymal cells lining ventricles or spinal canal
Distinct histopathology without multiple germ layers

redFlags: Signs of increased intracranial pressure with papilledema
New onset seizures in a child or young adult
references: Louis DN, Perry A, Reifenberger G, et al. The 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System: a summary. Neuro Oncol. 2021;23(8):1231-1251.
Orphanet: Teratoma of the Central Nervous System (ORPHA:252018)
Kleihues P, Cavenee WK. Pathology and Genetics of Tumors of the Nervous System. IARC Press; 2000.
